newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London weaker in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London weaker in quiet trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks retreated from their record Hong Kong close in quiet London trading on Tuesday, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was down 11.10 points at 12,795.21 by 1404 GMT, after a mixed session in Hong Kong saw the Hang Seng index close 34.45 points higher at a record 12,806.31.
Dealers said trade in London was lacklustre awaiting U.S. economic indicators later this week and any reaction in U.S. Treasury bonds. "All eyes on the U.S. bond market. This is key," said one.
The U.S. Federal Reserve's policy-making committee meets tomorrow for the first time since the U.S. presidential election but no change in rates is expected.
Hutchison Whampoa was up 25 HK cents HK$ 57.50 while Amoy Properties fell 75 HK cents at HK$ 9.87-1/2.
